'''2026 Retro U.S. Nationals''' was the Premiere-to-Death Star II side event at the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]] weekend in New Brunswick, New Jersey, 1 August 2026. [[Jonny Chu]] won undefeated.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-07-retro-u-s-nationals-prem-to-dsii-new-brunswick-new-jersey-aug-1-2026/ 2026-07 Retro U.S. Nationals – Prem to DSII – New Brunswick, New Jersey (Aug. 1, 2026)] (preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012175621/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-07-retro-u-s-nationals-prem-to-dsii-new-brunswick-new-jersey-aug-1-2026.html Internet Archive]), starwarsccg.org (10 August 2026).</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-us-nationals-wrap-up-win-for-hayes-hunter/ 2026 US Nationals Wrap-Up – Win for Hayes Hunter] (preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012180152/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-us-nationals-wrap-up-win-for-hayes-hunter.html Internet Archive]), starwarsccg.org.</ref>
